description: The plot illustrates the relationship between training time and loss for two different models, Vanilla Transformer and SepLLM. The x-axis is labeled “Training Time (s)” and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 250000, with tick marks every 50000 units. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and is a linear scale ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, with tick marks every 0.05 units. A purple line, representing Vanilla Transformer, is plotted with circular markers and begins at approximately 2.71 at a training time of 0 seconds, and declines to approximately 2.53 at a training time of 250000 seconds, exhibiting a steady decline with minor fluctuations. A red line, representing SepLLM, is plotted with circular markers and begins at approximately 2.72 at a training time of 0 seconds, and declines to approximately 2.51 at a training time of 250000 seconds, also demonstrating a steady decline with minor fluctuations, and has a dashed horizontal green line at approximately 2.50 on the y-axis.
